name: Fixture 5: triangulated truss
note: Spec 5 fixture 5, issue W2-07. A Warren truss spans the fixture 1 gap between surfaces 1 and 2: line 1 is the deck (nodes 1, 2, 3), line 2 the zigzag of diagonals (nodes 1, 4, 2, 5, 3), and line 3 the top chord (nodes 4, 5), 0.25 room units above the deck.
description: Positions are room units (Y up) and go through the scale adapter at Constants.Scale.RoomToBridge. Lines are stored as drawn, vertex to vertex; FixtureCalibrationTests divides each one the way the game does, with EqualSegments.SnapPolyline at Constants.Snapping.TargetSpacingMeters, which keeps these node ids. At 0.1 m that gives 10 deck segments, 4 on each diagonal, and 5 on the top chord, so the deck bends between panel points. One static solve carries Constants.Human.CarMassKg * Constants.Loads.Gravity downward in bridge-world, split equally across the free nodes of the divided deckLineId. Every member uses the Constants.Section tube with the Constants.Human material, so the file holds no section. The worst-member utilization must stay below Constants.Human.Fixture5MaximumUtilization.
